arxiv-1905-11847.title: On Collapsing Prefix Normal Words
arxiv-1905-11847.creator: Pamela Fleischmann, Mitja Kulczynski, Dirk Nowotka, Danny Bøgsted Poulsen
arxiv-1905-11847.description: Abstract Prefix normal words are binary words in which each prefix has at least the same number of 𝟣 \mathsf{1} s as any factor of the same length. Firstly introduced in 2011, the problem of determining the index (amount of equivalence classes for a given word length) of the prefix normal equivalence relation is still open.

arxiv-2104-06872.title: Dependent censoring based on copulas
arxiv-2104-06872.creator: Claudia C zado, Ingrid V an Keilegom
arxiv-2104-06872.description: Abstract Consider a survival time T T that is subject to random right censoring, and suppose that T T is stochastically dependent on the censoring time C C . We are interested in the marginal distribution of T T . This situation is often encountered in practice.

arxiv-2201-12282.title: Equilibrium solution for cold dynamical systems and self-similarity.
arxiv-2201-12282.creator: Alard, C
arxiv-2201-12282.description: Abstract Aims. Numerical simulations demonstrate a link between dynamically cold initial solutions and self-similarity. However the nature of this link is not fully understood. Cold initial conditions alone without further symmetry do not lead to self-similarity. Methods. Here we show that when the system approaches equilibrium a new symmetry appears.

arxiv-2202-09090.title: Cut-and-join operators in cohomological field theory and topological recursion
arxiv-2202-09090.creator: Alexander Alexandrov
arxiv-2202-09090.description: Abstract . We construct a cubic cut-and-join operator description for the partition function of the Chekhov–Eynard–Orantin topological recursion for a local spectral curve with simple ramification points. In particular, this class contains partition functions of all semi-simple cohomological field theories. The cut-and-join description leads to an algebraic version of topological recursion.

arxiv-2204-03007.title: The Prospects for Hurricane-like Vortices in Protoplanetary Disks Athena++ ( Stone et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , Numpy ( Walt et al. 2011 ) , Scipy ( Jones et al. 2001– )
arxiv-2204-03007.creator: Konstantin Gerbig, Gregory Laughlin
arxiv-2204-03007.description: Abstract When ice on the surface of dust grains in protoplanetary disk sublimates, it adds its latent heat of water sublimation to the surrounding flow. Drawing on the analogy provided by tropical cyclones on Earth, we investigate if this energy source is sufficient to sustain or magnify anticyclonic disk vortices that would otherwise fall victim to viscous dissipation.

arxiv-2301-05809.title: Who Should I Trust: AI or Myself? Leveraging Human and AI Correctness Likelihood to Promote Appropriate Trust in AI-Assisted Decision-Making CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in HCI
arxiv-2301-05809.creator: Shuai Ma, Ying Lei, Xinru Wang, Chengbo Zheng, Chuhan Shi, Ming Yin, Xiaojuan Ma
arxiv-2301-05809.description: Abstract . In AI-assisted decision-making, it is critical for human decision-makers to know when to trust AI and when to trust themselves. However, prior studies calibrated human trust only based on AI confidence indicating AI’s correctness likelihood (CL) but ignored humans’ CL, hindering optimal team decision-making.

arxiv-2407-00670.title: Pushforward measures on homogeneous spaces of non-unimodular groups and properties of modular functions
arxiv-2407-00670.creator: Takashi Satomi
arxiv-2407-00670.description: Abstract This paper shows that a formula for the pushforward measures on the fiber bundle G → G / H G\to G/H of homogeneous space of locally compact groups G G and H H can be written down by using the modular functions.

arxiv-2503-12171.title: Direct numerical simulation of nucleate boiling with a resolved microlayer and conjugate heat transfer
arxiv-2503-12171.creator: T. Long 1,2, J. Pan 2, E. Cipriano 3, M. Bucci 4, S. Zaleski 2,5
arxiv-2503-12171.description: Abstract In this paper, a phase-change model based on a geometric Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) framework is extended to simulate nucleate boiling with a resolved microlayer and conjugate heat transfer. Heat conduction in both the fluid and solid domains is simultaneously solved, with Interfacial Heat-Transfer Resistance (IHTR) imposed.

arxiv-2505-14984.title: CRAFT : Training-Free Cascaded Retrieval for Tabular QA
arxiv-2505-14984.creator: Jianxi Gao
arxiv-2505-14984.description: Abstract Table Question Answering (TQA) involves retrieving relevant tables from a large corpus to answer natural language queries. Traditional dense retrieval models, such as DTR and ColBERT, not only incur high computational costs for large-scale retrieval tasks but also require retraining or fine-tuning on new datasets, limiting their adaptability to evolving domains and knowledge.

arxiv-2507-03605.title: Behaviour Space Analysis of LLM-driven Meta-heuristic Discovery
arxiv-2507-03605.creator: Niki van Stein, Haoran Yin, Anna V. Kononova Thomas Bäck, Gabriela Ochoa
arxiv-2507-03605.description: Abstract We investigate the behaviour space of meta-heuristic optimisation algorithms automatically generated by Large Language Model driven algorithm discovery methods. Using the Large Language Evolutionary Algorithm (LLaMEA) framework with a GPT o4-mini LLM, we iteratively evolve black-box optimisation heuristics, evaluated on 10 functions from the BBOB benchmark suite. Six LLaMEA variants, featuring different mutation prompt strategies, are compared and analysed.

arxiv-2509-04031.title: Probing the Chern-Simons Portal at the HL-LHC through Displaced Vertices from W Boson Associated Production
arxiv-2509-04031.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . This study explores the Chern-Simons portal model, an extension of the Standard Model that introduces a massive neutral vector boson X X associated with a U X ​ ( 1 ) U_{X}(1) gauge symmetry. Motivated by gauge anomaly cancellation, the model incorporates heavy chiral fermions that induce observable effects through topological Chern-Simons interactions, despite being inaccessible at Large Hadron Collider energies.

arxiv-2509-23014.title: Planning with Unified Multimodal Models
arxiv-2509-23014.creator: Yihao Sun, Zhilong Zhang, Yang Yu, Pierre-Luc Bacon
arxiv-2509-23014.description: Abstract With the powerful reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), many recent works have explored using them for decision-making. However, most of these approaches rely solely on language-based reasoning, which limits their ability to reason and make informed decisions.

arxiv-2512-04798.title: Edge spin galvanic effect in altermagnets
arxiv-2512-04798.creator: L. E. Golub
arxiv-2512-04798.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by L. E. Golub. The edge spin galvanic effect (ESGE) in d d -wave altermagnets is proposed. ESGE is a creation of an electrical current flowing along the edge of the sample, which is driven by the spin orientation of charge carriers. The ESGE current is formed owing to the altermagnetic spin splitting and the scattering of carriers by the edge of the sample. The current is sensitive to the orientation of the edge in respect to the main axes of the altermagnet.

pmc-11305098.title: Water–air interface revisited by means of path-integral ab initio molecular dynamics†
pmc-11305098.creator: Fabrizio Creazzo, Sandra Luber
pmc-11305098.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Although nuclear quantum effects (NQEs) have been considered on bulk liquid water, the impact of these latter on the air–water interface has not yet been reported. Herein, by performing and comparing ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD) and path integral AIMD (PI-AIMD) simulations, we reveal the impact of NQEs on structural, dynamical and electronic properties as well as IR spectra of the air–water interface at room temperature.

pmc-13303384.title: 一种用于创面检测的改进Faster R-CNN方法
pmc-13303384.creator: Sisi ZHANG, Zhongxiang SHI, Feng JIANG, Min DING, Congcong LIU, Fei DUAN
pmc-13303384.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的 通过引入注意力增强机制和改进后处理策略，对更快的基于区域的卷积神经网络（faster region-based convolutional neural network, Faster R-CNN）进行改进，即用于创面检测的改进Faster R-CNN方法（wound detection method based on improved faster R-CNN, WD-IFRCNN），以提高创面检测的准确性和稳定性。方法①算法构建：以50层残差网络（50-layer residual network, ResNet-50）为主干网络，在第4残差阶段（convolutional stage 4, Conv4_x）和第5残差阶段（convolutional stage 5, Conv5_x）嵌入模糊注意力引导模块（fuzzy mask attention module, FMAM）协同的卷积块注意力模块（convolutional block attention module, CBAM），以增强模型对创面关键区域及边界模糊区域的特征表达能力；同时采用软非极大值抑制（soft non-maximum suppression, Soft-NMS）替代传统非极大值抑制策略，以减少重叠目标场景中的漏检。②算法验证：实验数据集由开源创面图像和临床采集图像构成，共740张原始图像，经数据增强后扩展至5920张，并采用十折交叉验证进行评估。通过内部验证、外部验证、超参数调优和消融实验，采用精确率、召回率、平均精确率和F1分数等指标对模型性能进行评价。结果①内部验证表明，同时在ResNet-50的Conv4_x和Conv5_x阶段嵌入CBAM时模型性能最佳；采用ResNet-50-CBAM作为主干网络时，模型检测效果优于VGG16和ResNet-50。②外部验证表明，WD-IFRCNN的精确率、召回率、平均精确率和F1分数分别达到92.31%、93.95%、92.33%和0.93，其中平均精确率较SSD、YOLOv4、YOLOv5、YOLOv8、DETR、RT-DETR和FR-CNN-FPN分别提高3.21%、2.30%、1.39%、0.86%、0.82%、0.37%和0.63%。③消融实验表明，CBAM、FMAM和Soft-NMS均对模型性能提升具有积极作用，三者联合时检测效果最佳。结论WD-IFRCNN能够有效增强模型对创面关键区域及模糊边界区域的特征表达能力，提高创面检测的准确性和稳定性，对复杂创面场景具有较好的适应性，可为临床创面评估与辅助诊断提供一定的技术支持。Keywords: 创面检测, Faster R-CNN, 卷积块注意力模块, 模糊注意力引导模块, 软非极大值抑制 创面检测在现代临床医学中占据着非常重要的地位，尤其是在创伤处理、慢性病管理以及术后护理等领域[1]。对创面进行准确检测及评估，不仅能够为医护人员提供重要的诊断依据，而且还能显著提升患者的治疗效果和康复质量。当前的临床中的创面检测主要依赖于医护人员的经验和直觉，这种方法不仅主观性强，而且容易受外界因素的干扰，导致诊断结果的准确性不高，并且大量消耗人力资源。此外，创面类型繁多，加之创面形态的复杂性以及创面位置的多样性，进一步增加了检测的难度。因此，通过机器学习技术来提高创面检测的准确性和效率，已经成为当前的研究热点[2-3]。 近年来，随着深度学习技术的发展，基于卷积神经网络（convolutional neural network, CNN）的目标检测为医学图像分析提供了更为有效的新方法[4]。作为典型的目标检测模型，更快的基于区域的卷积神经网络（faster region-based convolutional neural network, Faster R-CNN）在医学图像处理中表现良好。ZAOUK等[5]将Faster R-CNN应用于白血病和淋巴瘤分类，TALAAT等[6]将其用于前列腺癌检测，SARMUN等[7]则将其引入糖尿病足溃疡检测任务，均取得了较好效果。然而，现有方法在创面检测中仍存在一定不足：小目标特征在深层卷积和下采样过程中容易丢失；复杂背景、边界模糊及目标重叠等问题容易导致误检和漏检；医疗图像标注成本较高，数据集规模有限，也会影响模型的泛化能力。 针对上述问题，本文提出一种用于创面检测的改进Faster R-CNN方法（wound detection method based on improved faster R-CNN, WD-IFRCNN）。该方法以50层残差网络（50-layer residual network, ResNet-50）为主干网络，在网络中嵌入卷积块注意力模块（convolutional block attention module, CBAM）[8]和模糊注意力引导模块（fuzzy mask attention module, FMAM），并采用软非极大值抑制（soft non-maximum suppression, Soft-NMS）[9]算法抑制冗余边界框，以增强模型对创面区域尤其是小目标和模糊边界区域的检测能力。同时，本文结合多种数据增强方法扩展创面数据集规模和多样性，从而提升模型的泛化性能。实验结果表明，WD-IFRCNN能够更准确地识别和定位创面区域。 对象和方法 数据集 本研究经山东省立医院涉及人的生物医学研究伦理委员会批准，批准号省医伦批第SWYX:NO.2026-188号。通过开源数据集和医院临床采集两种方式构建实验数据集。其中，开源数据集包含创面图像284张，包括烧伤52张、割伤48张、擦伤80张和压疮104张；临床采集创面图像456张，其中急性创面157张、慢性创面299张。最终共获得740张原始创面图像。为提升数据集规模和多样性，本文对原始图像进行数据增强。经数据增强后，最终得到5920张创面图像。我们采用十折交叉验证法对数据集进行划分，在每一折中按照创面类型对样本进行分层采样，以保证训练集与测试集中不同创面比例分布基本一致。数据增强仅用于训练集，以扩展特征空间并降低过拟合风险，每一折测试集均保留74张原始图像，用于评价模型在真实临床场景下的检测性能。数据增强效果如网络资源附件附图1所示。
